title: Lift specified residue embeddings between fixed strict henselization models
statement: Let g:T→S be a scheme morphism and k,k′ separably closed fields, Ω an algebraically closed field, σ:Spec k→S, τ:Spec k′→T, ι:Spec k′→Spec k with ι≫σ=τ≫g, and ν:Spec Ω→Spec k′. Let A,B be strictly henselian local rings with separably closed residue fields, eA:Spec A≅S_(ν≫ι≫σ), eB:Spec B≅T_(ν≫τ), and residue embeddings ρA,ρB whose composites through the closed-point and structural maps equal σ and τ. Given a ring homomorphism r:κA→κB satisfying ρB≫Spec r=ι≫ρA, there exists a ring homomorphism φ:A→B such that residueB∘φ=r∘residueA and Spec φ≫eA≫j_s=eB≫j_t≫g. The residue embedding r and its spectral square are hypotheses, not constructed by this lifting statement. The scheme, geometric point, residue field, strictly henselian ring and strict-henselization constructions are those of [def-pc-scheme] [def-pc-separably-closed] [def-weil-geometric-point] [def-weil-residue-field] [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit] [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map].

proof.text: Choose an affine open i:Spec R→S containing the image of σ. The closed points of Spec A and Spec B have this image by hρA, hρB and hι. Every point of a local spectrum generalizes its closed point, so both structural maps factor through i. Full faithfulness of Spec gives compatible ring maps a:R→A and b:R→B.

Apply strictHenselization_indEtale_of_affine_chart to eA and a to obtain that A is ind-etale over R. Compose the spectral residue diagram with the chart maps; use hρA, hρB and hι, cancel the open immersion, and reflect equality through the injective residue-field map induced by ρB. This proves residueB∘b=r∘residueA∘a.

Choose an ind-etale colimit presentation of A. Identify the local residue fields with prime residue fields at the maximal ideals using their canonical quotient-field isomorphisms. Residue compatibility makes the contractions of the two maximal ideals equal and gives the required residue-field compatibility. Apply map_into_henselian_colimit and transport its prescribed reduction back to the local residue fields. The resulting R-algebra map φ has residueB∘φ=r∘residueA; its R-algebra compatibility gives the structural square after composing with i.

lean.statement:
theorem Etale.exists_compatibleStrictHenselizationResidueLift
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} {g : T ⟶ S}
    {k k' Ω A B : Type u} [Field k] [IsSepClosed k] [Field k'] [IsSepClosed k']
    [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [HenselianLocalRing A] [HenselianLocalRing B]
    [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)]
    [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)]
    (σ : Spec (.of k) ⟶ S) (τ : Spec (.of k') ⟶ T)
    (ι : Spec (.of k') ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (hι : ι ≫ σ = τ ≫ g)
    (ν : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of k'))
    (eA : Spec (.of A) ≅ strictLocalization (ν ≫ ι ≫ σ))
    (eB : Spec (.of B) ≅ strictLocalization (ν ≫ τ))
    (ρA : Spec (.of k) ⟶ Spec (.of (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)))
    (ρB : Spec (.of k') ⟶ Spec (.of (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)))
    (hρA : ρA ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue A)) ≫
      eA.hom ≫ strictLocalizationToBase (ν ≫ ι ≫ σ) = σ)
    (hρB : ρB ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue B)) ≫
      eB.hom ≫ strictLocalizationToBase (ν ≫ τ) = τ)
    (r : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A →+* IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)
    (hres : ρB ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom r) = ι ≫ ρA) :
    ∃ (φ : A →+* B),
      (IsLocalRing.residue B).comp φ = r.comp (IsLocalRing.residue A) ∧
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ eA.hom ≫
          strictLocalizationToBase (ν ≫ ι ≫ σ) =
        eB.hom ≫ strictLocalizationToBase (ν ≫ τ) ≫ g
